key_insight: EHR-Complex is a new benchmark that tests clinical agents on realistic, interactive EHR reasoning rather than simplified static SQL tasks.
clinical_relevance: It better reflects how clinicians and informatics tools must query complex, longitudinal patient records to support analysis at both patient and population levels.
method: Built on MIMIC-IV with 365K patients, 31 tables, and 500M+ records.
Includes ~52K tasks across six clinical intents.
Agents must interact with a sandbox via SQL or Python execution.
evidence_signal: The benchmark shows substantial difficulty: the best model reached only 62.3% exact-match accuracy, and pass@k consistency fell below 50% at k=4 for nearly all models.
watch_item: Results come from a sandboxed benchmark, so real-world deployment may face additional issues with data heterogeneity, workflow integration, and safety constraints.
paper_title: EHR-Complex: Benchmarking Medical Agents for Complex Clinical Reasoning
